objective_contribution: Make ContextBench token accounting robust to provider stalls while preserving an unchanged semantic comparison.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can exact pre-dispatch upper-bound debits and symmetric pair censoring preserve token safety while allowing a fresh GLM 8K ContextBench cohort to produce an interpretable H62 estimate?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Scorer adaptation, full local validation, fresh selection, repositories, scorer smoke, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and decision.

measurement_mapping.native: H62 quality uses the unchanged fixed eight-identity denominator; bounded failures produce symmetric arm zeros.
measurement_mapping.retention: The compact evidence slate remains the sole semantic treatment at the shared review boundary.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Every censored outcome requires a receipt-dispatch-admission proof and no retry.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Known model input plus output usage plus the full admitted input-plus-output reservation for each indeterminate call; never zero-imputed.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The accounting rule is model and task-domain independent; the live evidence remains GLM code-context development evidence.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: Continue independent tasks only after a validator-proven bounded local failure; all other unknown states stop globally.

retained_counterevidence: Round 41 completed 29 responses and seven recycling transitions before a 900-second zero-byte deadline.
Round 41 produced no review pair, so H62 remains unmeasured there.
Round 40 produced four neutral pairs before a separate 300-second zero-byte deadline.
successor_rule: If H63 passes, interpret H62 only with at least six complete pairs; an H62 pass advances to larger fresh replication, while failure selects H58 or new evidence-led semantics.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The rule minimizes and upper-bounds cumulative tokens rather than optimizing latency.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The experiment repairs an instrument blocker before interpreting semantics.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 41 observations select H63 against H64 and retain H58 as the semantic alternative.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Both provider deadlines and incomplete H62 evidence remain explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Exact usage and conservative upper-bound debit are distinct reported fields.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Fresh development only; no benchmark clearance claim.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Malformed or incomplete bound chains fail closed in unit tests.
